info.name: Support Ticket Triage Agent
info.description:
Live-test collection for the FastAPI triage service (`uvicorn triage_agent.api:app --port 8000`).

Flow: 1) Health → 2) Samples → 3) Triage ticket-1/2/3 → 4) Custom + batch → 5) direct mock-tool checks (no LLM key needed).

Without an LLM key every `/triage` call fail-closes to `escalate to human` (confidence 0.5). Set `LLM_PROVIDER` + provider key in `.env` for the real LLM path.
